messages.author: 544969534fdcd767
messages.subject: methylKit with nanopore WGS
parts:
Hi all !
Has anyone tried using methylKit with nanopore WGS data along with modkit ? If yes, any tips on the data input formating will be greatly appreciated.
Many thanks,
Selma.

messages.author: 2503791e62835891
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] methylKit with nanopore WGS
parts:
Hi Selma,

Yes, I used methylKit with my nanopore data output from modkit, adapting the input formating from generic file from the reference manual, pg. 42: 
myobj=methRead( generic.file, pipeline=list(fraction=FALSE,chr.col=1,start.col=2,end.col=2,
coverage.col=4,strand.col=3,freqC.col=5), sample.id="test1",assembly="hg18")

Considering the output from modkit, here's what my script looks like to input as a flat file:

file.list=list(“file1.bed”, “file2.bed”, “file3.bed”, “file4.bed”)

raw_TV_CG_DB=methRead(file.list,sample.id=list(“T1”, “T2”, “T3”, “T4”),                assembly="PN",header=FALSE,context="CpG",resolution="base", treatment=c(1,1,0,0),       pipeline=list(fraction=FALSE,chr.col=1,start.col=3,end.col=3,coverage.col=10,strand.col=6,freqC.col=11),mincov=5, dbtype=”"tabix",dbdir="/path_to_dir")

Hope that helps,

Cheers,
Cen

parts:

I haven't got that problem with my data. I am not sure why it didn't work for your data, but one thing I can think of is, did you run your modkit pileup with The --only-tabs flag? ( see https://github.com/nanoporetech/modkit/issues/43), so your bed file has tab-delimited for the entire columns?

Cen
